interpretation: The locked f41 MaxT window is usable only as a predictive proxy. It is never a resolution-equivalent local-day outcome label in the evaluated US cohort.
allowed_use: PROXY_18H_MAX feature with per-row overlap, omitted-hour, outside-hour, timezone, and DST metadata
forbidden_use: Treat f41 TXNMN/TXNP as the actual local-calendar-day maximum temperature
next_step: Build a bounded stratified US event/price/NBM pilot dataset and measure proxy forecast skill before full-scale ingestion.
